name: 不原谅不复婚她另攀高枝
original_name: 不原谅不复婚她另攀高枝
overview: After her husband’s betrayal leads to heartbreak and a tragic miscarriage, Qiao Weixi ends their seven-year marriage and leaves for Paris to rebuild her life. Three years later, she returns as a celebrated painter and begins working with rising businessman Lu Jingshen, who quickly becomes both her ally and protector.
